title: Abhorsen
author: Garth Nix
note: conf=0.97; ISBN 9781741769579 matches an Australian (Allen & Unwin) ebook edition of Abhorsen per Goodreads/Booktopia. Amazon lists it as "Old Kingdom Book 3"; it is the concluding volume of the original trilogy after Sabriel (1) and Lirael (2). Series sometimes called "Abhorsen Trilogy"; "Old Kingdom" is the canonical/publisher series name and matches the filename.
